name: gmail
description: Reads Gmail for what is waiting on you and what you are waiting on: threads whose last message is to you, and threads where you sent last and got no reply. Read-only.

waiting-on-me.prompt: Use the waiting-on-me skill to find what is waiting on me on Gmail.

waiting-on-them.prompt: Use the waiting-on-them skill to find what I am waiting on others for on Gmail.

action-now.prompt: Use the waiting-on-me and action-now-or-soon skills to answer action-now: what I need to act on today on Gmail.

action-soon.prompt: Use the waiting-on-me and action-now-or-soon skills to answer action-soon: what I need to act on soon on Gmail.

all.prompt: Answer all four triage questions on Gmail, following triage-report: action-now, action-soon, waiting-on-them, then the counts.
